definitions.full: H5387. nasiy ' I. נָשִׂיא 128 noun masculine one lifted up , i.e. a chief prince; — absolute ׳נ Exod 22:27 +; construct נְשִׂיא Gen 23:6 +; plural נְשִׂיאִים Josh 22:32 +, נְשִׂיאִים 22:32 +, נְשִׂאִים Exod 34:31 7 t., נְשִׂיאִם Gen 17:20 3 t., נְשִׂאִם Exod 35:27 ; construct נְשִׂיאֵי 16:22 +; suffix נְשִׂיאַי Ezek 45:8 , נְשִׂיאֶיהָ 32:29 , נְשִׂיאֵיהֶם Numbers 17:21, נְשִׂיאֵהֶם Numbers 17:17, etc.; — mostly in Israel: 1 ׳נ בְּעַמְּךָ of any chief man, Exod 22:27 (E; human ruler, over against אֱלֹהִים ). 2 of Solomon 1Kin 11:34 . Elsewhere only Ezekiel, P, Chronicles: — 3 of Abraham Gen 23:6 , and heads of Ishmaelite tribes 17:20 ; 25:16 . 4 rulers of the congregation , הָעֵדָה נְשִׂיאֵי Exod 16:22 ; Josh 9:15 , 18 ; 22:30 , ׳הַנּ בָּעֵדָה Exod 34:31 , compare 35:27 ; Lev 4:22 ; Josh 9:18 b; 9:19 , 21 (twice in verse); 17:4 ; 22:14 (3 t. in verse); 22:32 (all P); especially 5 tribal chiefs and representatives , according to the religious organization of P, Num 1:16 , 44 ; 2:3 57t. Numbers (especially chapters 2, 7, 34; note הַלֵּוִי נְשִׂיאֵי נְשִׂיא 3:32 ); compare 1Chr 2:10 ; 4:38 ; 5:6 ; 7:40 ; 2Chr 1:2 , also 1Kin 8:1 (probably gloss, omitted by ᵐ5 Benz), 2Chr 5:2 . 6 in Ezekiel: a. of Zedekiah (for מֶלֶךְ see Böhmer 8K 1900, 112 ff. ), Ezek 7:27 ; 12:10 , 12 ; 21:30 , + 19:1 (read singular ᵐ5 Ew Hi Co Berthol Toy). b. chief men of Judah Ezek 21:17 ; 22:6 ; 45:8-9 ,. c. future Davidic king Ezek 34:24 ; 37:25 , compare 44:3 (twice in verse) + 16 t. Ezekiel 45, 46, 48. d. foreign princes Ezek 26:16 ; 27:21 ; 30:13 ; 32:29 ; 38:2-3 , 39:1 , 18 . 7 leader of exiles returning under Cyrus, according to Ezra 1:8 . 8 non-Israel chiefs in P: Gen 34:2 ; Num 25:18 ; Josh 13:21 . II. [ נָשִׂיא ] noun [masculine] rising mist, vapour (Arabic , ); — only plural נְשִׂאִים vapours , forming clouds, and portending rain, Jer 10:13 = 51:16 , Psa 135:7 , נְשִׂיאִים Prov 25:14 .
